retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic sepia-toned studio portrait of a couple in an intimate embrace, featuring high-contrast 1970s geometric sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, monochromatic sepia-toned photograph of a man and woman in a close, shirtless embrace. The lighting is soft but directional, emphasizing the texture of hair and skin. The composition is tight, focusing on the faces and hands, with a flat, neutral background that matches the mid-tones of the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic sepia color palette across subjects and background
Interlocking physical forms creating a central visual mass
High-contrast white typography framing the central figures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The couple occupies the central 80% of the frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of near-contact between the two faces in the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left name, down the man's arm to the woman's face, then to the bottom title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the upper corners and around the perimeter.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between shadows and highlights to create depth.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a wide, sweeping curve
The 'R' features a large bowl and a curved leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in different positions for names and title.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the circular geometry and 70s aesthetic.
Matches the wide proportions and low crossbars.
Provides the correct geometric skeleton and era-appropriate feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned studio photograph of a man with a beard and a woman with curly hair in a shirtless, intimate embrace against a solid brown background. Use soft 1970s film lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white. Place names in the top left and top right corners, and the main title centered at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic sepia?
Is the typography a geometric sans-serif?
Does the lighting feel soft and diffused like 70s film?

mustRedesign: San-serif fonts with high stroke contrast
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleed outside the sepia range
Verify the 'S' and 'O' characters are perfectly circular
Check that the skin tones are smooth but textured
Confirm the composition remains centered and intimate
